purpose: Define how P5-B4 should prepare a small manually reviewed real-source fixture before any expanded real Chuo ingestion.
requiredPreconditions: Project-local Python environment is created or verified with jsonschema and pytest available.
Source provenance review template entries are completed manually for selected candidate sources.
License or terms review is recorded before any real source fixture is committed.
No source is treated as official until manual review confirms owner, URL, terms, and update date semantics.
CRS strategy and processing CRS candidate are documented before spatial operations.
expectedInputTypes: small manually reviewed official shelter/facility point table
small manually reviewed official evacuation building table if available
small manually reviewed hazard context reference table or QA note

fixtureSizeTarget.plateauBuildingRecords: controlled placeholder or small approved sample only
fixtureSizeTarget.routeRecords: none in P5-B4 unless separately approved

licenseReviewRequirements: Confirm source owner and official authority.
Record license or terms URL/text summary.
Record whether redistribution of a small derived fixture is allowed.
Record whether raw source files must remain local and uncommitted.
CRSRequirements: Record source CRS for every fixture record or source batch.
Do not compute meter distances in EPSG:4326.
Use a projected CRS suitable for Tokyo/Chuo before any metric matching.
Keep Unity coordinate conversion deferred to P5-C.
validationRequirements: JSON syntax validation for fixture and provenance files.
JSON Schema validation for qualification outputs when jsonschema is available.
Focused tests for official/candidate boundary behavior.
Manual review warnings for missing update dates, ambiguous source fields, or unclear license terms.
No raw large GIS files or full official datasets committed.
manualReviewChecklist: Source update date recorded or explicitly unknown.
Approval status remains not_approved until review is complete.
risks: Official records may be address-only or spatially ambiguous.
License terms may allow use but not redistribution.
Source update dates may be missing or unclear.
A facility may span multiple PLATEAU buildings.
Small manually reviewed fixtures can overfit early assumptions.
nextActions: P5-B4 should complete source provenance review entries for selected sources.
P5-B4 should create a small controlled real-source fixture only after review.
P5-B4 should generate schema-shaped controlled real qualification outputs without full dataset processing.
